subject: General Knowledge
title: Class 9 General Knowledge Olympiad — Paper 4
instructions: The time allowed for this paper is 60 minutes.
This paper contains 50 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions carrying a total of 60 marks.
There is no negative marking for wrong answers.
Each question has four options; choose the one correct answer.
Section 1 and other regular sections carry 1 mark per question; the Achievers Section carries 3 marks per question.
Use of calculators is not permitted unless specified.

questions.question: Which habit best reflects empathy?
options: Trying to understand and share the feelings of others
Focusing only on your own needs

questions.question: What is the healthiest way to handle failure in a test?
options: Giving up on the subject entirely
Reflecting on what went wrong and making an improvement plan
Comparing yourself negatively to top scorers

questions.question: What is the best way to build a healthy daily routine as a student?
options: Balancing study, exercise, sleep, and leisure time consistently

questions.question: If a classmate is being excluded from group activities, what is the most responsible action?
options: Include them and encourage others to be welcoming
Join in the exclusion to fit in
Talk about it only with friends, not the classmate

questions.question: Which action best demonstrates good leadership in a group project?
options: Taking credit for the group's work
Listening to everyone's ideas and making fair decisions

questions.question: Which of these best demonstrates good time management during exam preparation?
options: Creating and following a realistic study timetable
Studying without breaks for many hours straight

questions.question: What is the best approach when you disagree with a friend's opinion?
options: Argue loudly to prove your point
Listen respectfully and share your viewpoint calmly
Involve others to gang up against them

questions.question: What is an effective way to manage exam-related stress?
options: Practicing deep breathing and staying organized in preparation

questions.question: Which behaviour shows responsible use of social media?
options: Thinking before posting and respecting others' privacy
Sharing others' private information without permission

questions.question: A country invests significantly in girls' education over a decade. What is a likely long-term social impact of this investment?
options: Improved literacy rates, workforce participation, and overall economic development

questions.question: During a natural disaster like an earthquake, why is community disaster-preparedness training important?
options: It equips people with knowledge to respond quickly and safely, reducing casualties
It replaces the need for emergency services

questions.question: Two countries sharing a border have a long-standing trade agreement. If one country imposes sudden tariffs, what is a likely consequence for cross-border trade?
options: Trade will increase due to tariffs
Trade volume between the two countries may decrease due to increased costs
Only the imposing country will be affected
There will be no change in trade patterns

questions.question: A city switches its public buses from diesel to electric power over five years. What is a likely long-term benefit for the city's residents?
options: Higher public transport fares only, with no health benefit
Reduced air pollution and improved public health outcomes

questions.question: If a country experiences rapid inflation, what is a likely immediate effect on the purchasing power of its citizens?
options: There is no effect on purchasing power
Purchasing power decreases as prices rise faster than income
